elements.name: path_for_file
elements.brief: Resolves an absolute path for a file inside one of the system
elements.description:
Resolves an absolute path for a file inside one of the system
directories.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.doc: The file name, or a path relative to `directory`. Pass nothing to get the directory itself.

parameters.name: directory
parameters.doc: The base directory constant. Default is {@link directories.resource}.

returnvalues.doc: The resolved absolute path, or nothing when the directory cannot be created or resolved.
